dimensions.name: Governance Awareness
dimensions.rationale: Every stage in the pattern lifecycle flow loaded and respected governance rules. All 8 reasoning spans achieved schema validation successfully across semantic contracts and formal schemas without validation failure events.

dimensions.name: Causal Reasoning Depth
dimensions.rationale: The progression demonstrated clear causal continuity: rules and pattern extraction directly informed signal-to-pattern proposals, followed by scoping classification, promotion recommendations, and downstream reference architecture generation.

dimensions.name: Architectural Tension Analysis
dimensions.rationale: Tensions across agentic versus structural pattern trade-offs were properly classified and resolved during scope classification and pattern promotion before emitting concrete reference architectures.
